name: vrooli
description: Governed project CLI for the Vrooli control plane and scenario fleet.

groups.name: agent
groups.description: Run an interactive coding-agent CLI through the governed project surface.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Launch an allowlisted coding-agent CLI with inherited terminal input and output.

flags.name: prompt
flags.description: Optional non-interactive prompt passed to the runner.

flags.name: cwd
flags.description: Optional working directory for the runner.

flags.name: arg
flags.description: Additional argv token passed to the runner.

exception.reason: The governed command delegates to one explicitly allowlisted coding-agent executable while preserving argv boundaries and the caller's terminal streams.

options.name: claim
options.description: Path this session will edit; a live holder of an overlapping claim is named and the launch continues (advisory).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List live coding-agent sessions from the runtime registry: session, agent, tree, scope, pid, age, claims, frozen.

groups.name: scenario
groups.description: Inspect and manage the Vrooli scenario fleet.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate every scenario manifest and derived supervision intent.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List scenarios known to the Vrooli control plane.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Read one scenario's runtime and manifest status.

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Read a bounded tail of one scenario's lifecycle log.

flags.name: follow
flags.description: Follow log output in real time

flags.name: step
flags.description: View a specific background step log

flags.name: previous
flags.description: View the previous step log backup (.log.bak)

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start one scenario through the managed lifecycle.

flags.name: force
flags.description: Rebuild artifacts even when their inputs are fresh

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Ceiling for the whole start in seconds

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop one scenario through the managed lifecycle.

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Restart one scenario through the managed lifecycle.

flags.name: force
flags.description: Rebuild artifacts even when their inputs are fresh

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Ceiling for the whole restart in seconds

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Run one scenario's governed setup phase.

groups.name: management
groups.description: Scenario management commands retained under the scenario invocation path.

commands.description: Delete a scenario through the governed local scenario handler.

commands.name: timings
commands.description: Read recorded scenario lifecycle timing observations.

commands.name: break-glass
commands.description: Provision and issue target-bound break-glass credentials.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Plan and apply removal of recorded Vrooli installation artifacts.

commands.name: issue
commands.description: Issue a short-lived target-bound break-glass credential.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report break-glass material metadata without reading the private key.

commands.name: census
commands.description: Report resource declarations and installed CLI state.

commands.name: acceleration
commands.description: Inspect accelerator declaration, readiness and placement.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain declared accelerator backends and observed placement.

commands.name: cron
commands.description: Audit repository-owned user-cron declarations and installed entries.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Report what would be fetched without downloading.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Report the managed change without applying it.

commands.name: volume
commands.description: Inspect and manage host volume state.

groups.name: workload
groups.description: Observe host workloads and classify their Vrooli ownership posture.

commands.description: List observed host workloads with their Vrooli ownership posture.

flags.name: posture
flags.description: Select whole-host or Vrooli-only workload classification.

flags.name: check-writes

commands.name: list
